Bug_Title: Classes should not be compared by name
Bug_Explanation: The code compares class names using getClass().getSimpleName() and getName(), which can lead to incorrect type identification due to non-unique class names across different packages.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by comparing class names using getSimpleName() which leads to incorrect behavior if two classes have the same simple name. The test cases check for this faulty logic by passing objects and classes that should not match based on their actual class but match due to name comparison.
